subject: Free coding clubs for your students this fall
preheader: Nuevo Foundation brings volunteer-led coding clubs to your school at no cost.
title: Bring a free coding club to your school
intro: My name is Ana and I coordinate school partnerships for Nuevo Foundation, a nonprofit that brings hands-on computer science to students who do not yet have access to it.
We are scheduling fall clubs now and would love to reserve a spot for your students.

program.name: After-school coding club
program.format: Two volunteers per classroom, school provides the room and laptops
program.duration: One hour per week for eight weeks
program.cost: Free for the school and for families

highlights: An introduction to programming through games and storytelling projects
A finished project each student can share with their family
Role models from local technology companies, including bilingual volunteers
nextSteps: If this sounds like a fit, reply with two or three times that work for a 20 minute call and we will handle the scheduling and volunteer background checks.
